tei:div.tei:p: lha dbang sprul pa dpal ldan shar dga'i byung tshul yod/

'gro kun dga' mdzad dpal ldan sa skya pas/ /mkhyen brtse'i thugs rje'i nam mkha' yangs pa las/ /shar ri'i rtse nas 'od stong 'bar ba bzhin/ /shar phyogs ldan pa las kyis shar dga' ba/ /rigs bzang khungs btsun lha dbang rnams 'phrul ltar/ /'ga' zhig phas rgol 'alung kladapungablu'ajoms dmag dpon rin chen dang*/ /ding sang bstan pa'i srog shing chos rgyal chen po'ang byon | des na bde bas thub bstan gsal byed dang*/ /mdzad pa'i rnam thar rgyal mtshan grangs mang yang*/ /ngo mtshar 'phrin las rags pa zur tsam bris/ /de yang dpal ldan shar dga' bar grags 'di pa'i byon tshul ni/ rigs mtho ba/ sgang ldan kre'o gsum gyi yul khams la dbang bsgyur 'basaklaba'iblu/ jo bo'i rigs su gyur cing rus bzang ba/ bod mi'u drug gi nang nas/ smu tsha lha'i gdung rgyud kyi nang tshan ldan ma'i bu rgyud ste/ dang po khri srong lde btsan gyis dus su/ ldan ma rtse 'ayang klamangabluzer ba'i/ sgra sgyur gyis lots+tsha ba chen po dang*/ ldan ma byang khri/ byang dmar la sogs/ ma sangs kyis sprul pa'ang mang du byon par 'dug tsha drang btsun pa ni/ ldan stod lga'i yul du/ lga ags snyan dam pa zer ba'i/ 'byor ldan dkar phyogs la mos pa byung 'dug pas/ de lga ldan kre bo'i sa phyogs su/ lha khang rgya phibs khyung mgo can brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha khang de'i nang du rten ngo mtshar can dang*/ bka' 'gyur ro cog cha tshang ma re re bzhengs pa'i drung du dkar me 'khor yug mchod pa rnams lnga'i rgyun ma bcad pa'i dge rgyun btsugs pa lags so/ /bstan pa dar rgyas 'phel ba'i bya ba chen mo mdzad 'dug de'i dbon sras kyis rgyud pa/ ldan ma dbon po bzang po rgyan mtshan man/ yab sras 'khor bcas kyis dbus gtsang dag pa zhing khams/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya bla ma'i/ spyan sngar byon par bzhed nas/ yar btegs byon pas/ mi shi ba lha ru song ba'i ldan ma dbang rgyal zhes par grags pa

| lha btsan bzang po gcig yod pa des/ rmi lam du lung rim par bstan pa bzhin | gtsang g.yas ru'i ru lag lcug pa yu ba gdong*/ bzhi dga' gser sdings rnams su rim pas phyugs/ gser sdings su gzhi phab/ sras po de gzhon nu nas klog yig sogs yon tan dang ldan pas/ grong pa rnams kyang*/ dpon yig bzang po dpal 'dis/ rang re thams cad la phan thogs par byung zer cing | gnas po phyug po chen po gcig yod pa'ang*/ bu chung la zhe mgu nas/ nga'i bu mo dang bza' mi gyis cig zer nan gyis bskul bas/ bu mo lha mo slan dang*/ yab yum du 'brel/ lo 'ga' song pa dang*/ pha rgan sku gshegs/der rting bu mo la rmi ltas bzang po byung nas/ bya lo la sras po gcig 'khrungs pa/ mtshan dpal ldan dar zhes par btags so/ /yang lha'i lung bstan la/ 'di nas shar lho phyogs kyis la rgyab ba'i pha rol der song cig der nga'i 'dug nas kyang 'chos la/ rten tshugs bya ba thams cad kyang yar 'phel du 'byung ngo zer ba byung nas/ yab yum sras kyis yar byon/ thar pa dgon sar/ lcam ston chos 'phags kyis drung du/ sras pho la dge snyen zhus/ bla ma'i mtshan la dras nas | 'phags pa dpal bzang po zer ba'i mtshan btags/ 'phags pa'i ming can mi rabs bdun gyis bar la/ bstan byus mnga' thang yar 'phel du 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i bka' gnang*/ de nas lar rgan la byon ste/ bod mkhar sngon mo lung du bzhugs pa'i nub mo/ lha byon nas 'dir mkhar bzhis phob | nga'i lha rten tshugs zer ba byung nas bzhugs pas/ lha yul sngon mo lung du grags pa byung ngo*/ /de'i skabs su/ yul pa rnams/ sa skyar 'dab skor 'bul du 'gro dus yig ris dgos pas grogs ldan la/ dpon yig bzang po dpal bas kyang*/ thengs 'ga' byon pas/ sa skya nas nang chen gyis yig mkhan la bgor/ de nas yun ring ma 'gyangs par/ bla ma bdag nyid chen mo bzang po dpal bas drung du/ yig tshang pa'i mthil bzhugs thob/thugs rjes bzung nas mnga' thang yar 'phel du byung zhing*/

ma gcig lha mo sman la | | sras pho 'phags pa'i rin chen dang*/ ma sangs dar po dang*/ sngon mo lung du 'khrungs so/ /sras che ba la klog yig mkhas par bslabs/ gzhon nu nyid nas sa skya/ bla ma'i drung du skyabs/ ma sangs kyi sprul par song nas gzhan las 'khrungs bskyed che zhing*/ bya ba'i rnams dbye shin tu mkhas pa gcig byung bas | khams pa dge 'dun rgyan mtshan rnams/ dung reng gis kha non la sngags pa'i zla la/ yi ge shes pa gcig yang dgos pa byung bas/ khong pa btang*/ khams pa mi bdun po'i thog drangs rgan pa gong gsum bar dgar byas pa'i/ shar dga' bar grags pa de nas byung*/ khams pa rang bzhugs rin la'ang*/dung reng gis kha non rab tu byung zhing*/ khong pa bon nag 'od chen du sku gshegs/ zhal chems bzhag pa bzhin/ dpon yig 'phags pa dpal ba/ dpon tshab tu khur | mdun ma rtse gcig tu 'gril pa'i chad 'gag bsdams/ dpal ldan shar dga' ba'i bstan pa'i mgo sngan ma de nyid nas tshugs par byed do/ /gsum de mtshams dbus gtsang khri skor gyis dmag gi dung reng la 'gag sgugs/ 'thad 'ded byed par bshams pa/ shar dung rnams ring ldan zur la 'chur/ khos pha rol nas gur sha'i ri phug la 'chur dus/ gong gsum gyis sgar pas 'thar 'ded rtsis la/ dung reng dpon don grub dar gyi lam skrad nas/ dpon 'phags pa dpal khyod bsam pa che na/ nged rnams la chas kha sbyin 'alas klanasabluthong*/ zla ma rting ma la/ ngo blta sleb pa byed zer bas/ de'i phugs khebs che bar 'dug bsam nas/ gtsang mar btang bas sa skya nas nyes pa la thug pa khad tsam byung nas/ bzang chad byas lugs zhus pas/ zla dus la don grub dar gyis shar dung gis mi sna drag btus thams cad khrid/ mi khyod kyis bzang po byas phyin/ nga yang bzang po byed pa yin zer nas/ mi nor thams cad ngo bltas/ drag pa rnams las 'dzin la bcug gzhis chags nas/ dung reng gis mi rgyud/ nyang stod na da lta'ang yod do/

/der rting phag ri rin chen sgang dang*/ lho spa gro ban 'phreng ba'i/ blon po grags pa 'od zer 'jam grengs skug gzhan slu rgod thams cad kha drangs nas lho dung thams cad btul/ nag che ba rnams kyi mgo lag rin chen sgang gi mgon khang*/ them 'og na yod/ der rting bla ma'i bka' bzhin/ phag ri rnam rgyal gyis rdzong brtsigs/ lho dung gis sa chad thams cad 'og tu bcug las sgo che chung rnams btsugs rdzong dpon sngan ma la gcung po 'phags rin pa bskos/ de ltar shar dung*/ lho dung*/ rim par thul bas dpon jus dang*/ rang don grub pa shin tu che bar byung*/ de ltar sa skya nang chen gyis go sar yang lo 'ga' bzhugs shing*/ mi rtsag pa sag shi dar ra kha che/ ti shri kun rgyal bas phyag phyir gong du brdzangs/ hor rgyal po tho gan thi mur la zhus nas sidha ིta'i mtshan dang*/ dam ltag 'jal bslangs/ sham po rtse dgu'i ldan la/ lha khang dang bde yangs chen mo bzhengs/ chos sde btab rdzong rtse chen zer bar ming btags/ rgyal mkhar gyis ri bsrung pa'i/ rtse khang dang*/ lcang ra/ brgya grong gis sa mkhar brtsigs/ der rting phag mo grub pa swi tu byang rgyal ba dang*/thugs nye 'brel zab po yod pas/ sne gdong du byon zer ba byung ba la/ thugs bkal nas byon pas/ swi tu pa grongs pa dang thug gros pa rnams kyis/ bra phyi tshong 'dus su bzang btson la bgor dus su 'chags klaphyagabluphyi ba/ dge slong shan bzang dang*/ a po bkra hor/ yar lung dge bsnyen la sogs/ dpon zhen can rnams kyi sems khur byas pas/ gtsang mar thon/ yar byon/ gnas 'asnying klarnyingabludu bzhugs/ rtse chen lcang ra/ rgya grong nang na phag rin pa sku mched bzhugs pa la/ sne gdong nas nag po tshul bzang dang*/ dpag shing dkon mchog skyabs/ mda' phog nas 'das pas/ dmag dpung gros thabs la phyir log dgos byung nas/ shar dga' ba'i bstan byus kyis gzhi gcig de nas tshugs par byed do/

/twi si tu 'phags pa dpal bzang po'i sras che ba/ nang chen kun dga' 'phags pas yong / rgyal mkhar rtse rdzong dang*/ 'dug chung gi sa mkhar bzhengs/ stag rtse rdzong phag mo grub pa'i lag nas blangs/ sa skya nang chen gyis khog par zhugs nas/ sde srid chen po'i bstan byus yar 'phel gyis mdzad 'phrin rgya che bar mdzad/ cung po ta'i si tu dpal bas| rdzong rtse chen bzung*/ phyi nang 'dangakladublu/ dgra zun gyi blang dor/ sde gsar gyis ris dgos pa byung na'ang*/ ma sangs kyis sprul pa/ thabs la mkhas pa'i skyes bu dpal mdzangs 'dzoms 'dug pas/mthar thug dgra 'asnyenaklaganyenablublang dor ma nor pa'i 'dul sbyongs/ sa skya ba'i zhabs tog spyi byus su che ba dang*/ ma las bu dga' ba'i rdzong bzhi/ shab seng ge rtse/ sde chen rtse| 'jad bo dong la sogs pa'i mnga' zhabs gsar 'phel rim par chod cing*/ rgya'i twa'i ming rgyal pos/ twa'i si tu'i mtshan/ dngul dam lung bzang po dang bcas pa gnang nas | dpal ldan sa skya bas thog drangs/ gtsang srid spyi dgos kyis bstan pa'i srog shing lta bur bzhugs pa 'di lags so/ /de'i sras che ba dpon po rgya mtsho pa/ sku na gzhon rab la sku gshegs/ gcung po dbon po rin chen 'phags pa la/ ta'i ming rgyal pos/ su swi las kha na'ang cing*/ sde srid 'dzin skyong gis phra rags thams cad yab las mi zhan pa byung ba'i/ snyan grags yar 'phel du bzhugs so/ /'phags pa rin po che'i sras che ba/ brtse chen chos rje pa mdo rgyud kyis dgongs pa rnams thugs su chud ste/ rnal 'byor gyis dbang phyug chen po de nyid kyis 'gro ba'i 'dren pa la sku bstan par bzhugs so/ /de'i gcung po rgyal chen pa/ yang dpon po shākya dpal ba dang*/ chen po dbang rgyal bas/ sa skya nang chen bzung*/ nang ltar gyis mthun sbyor mdzad pa dang*/ mi mthun phyogs rnams kyis spyi thogs su/ ri bo ltar rjid pa gcig byon par gda'o/

/yang ma sangs dar po'i sras/ a chen bzang po dpal ba yin cing*/ de'i sras dpon rin chen rgyan mtshan dpal ba dang*/ nor bu 'phags pa yin no/ /nang chen kun dga' 'phags pa'i sras/ mched gsum gyi che ba/ rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pa nyang stod gya grong du/ ma gcig bzang mo dpal ba la/ sa mo sbrul lo 'byung ba lnga ldan gyi thog tu sku 'khrungs 'di nyid ni nges par byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa ste/ rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad 'phrin rgya che lugs ni 'ardzogs klabarjodablupar mi nus kyis/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rags pa tsam zhig khrims gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan par bya ba na| dang por sku gzhon nu'i dus su zhi dul dang ldan pa sogs/ chos mthun gyis yon tan du mas mdzes shing*/ dgung lo bcu gsum bcu bzhi nas| sems dpa' pa chen po chos kyi rin chen gyi zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs/ rjes su bzung*/ nyi shu ba la yab mes khu dbon pas thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir sgrub mchod chen mo'i gzhi btsugs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la yab dang yum gyis sku drin bsab pa'i phyir/ sgrub mchod yun ring dang gzhi rten bzang po btsugs/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la mkhyen rab kyis mnga' bdag dge legs dpal bas thog drangs| lung rigs smra ba brgya phrag bzhi lhag 'du ba'i lcang ra chos kyis gzhi bting*| nyi shu rtsa drug pa la/ nyang chu la zam chen bkag che dang bcas pa bzhengs/ sum cu pa la gos sku chen mo ston pa'i sku khru brgya cu pa dang*/ der rting gser 'phan chen mo'i dbus na/ byams pa'i sku khru bzhi cu pa dang*/ gzhan yang gos dar la khru bdun cu re yod pa'i 'phan brgyad rnams bzhengs/ rdo rje gdan gyis mkhan po/ ma hā so ma sogs rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta du ma spyan drangs/ bdag rkyen bzang po mdzad/ der rting yang bstan pa'i bdag po de nyid kyis thugs la/ sems can gyis bde skyid sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa la rag las/

bstan pa'i gsal byed/ lung rtogs thos bsam la rag las 'dug pas/ bstan pa dar zhing yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ dge 'dun 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa gcig kyang bzhengs dgos dgongs pa byung nas | thub pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum stong lnga brgya lnga cu rtsa gsum song pa'i | sa pho khyi lo la mnga' bdag dpal khri btsan gyi pho brang rgya gar rtse'i nye 'khor la sogs su/ chos grwa chen mo dpal 'khor sde chen/ gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa'i 'gram bting*/ lung rigs smra ba brgya phrag bcu dang*/ rim gnyis zab mo la brtson pa rgya phrag lnga tsam/ rtse gcig sgrub pa la brtson pa brgya phrag la sogs/ dge 'dun 'du ba'i sde btsugs dge ba bcus khrims bcas/'batsan klagatsangablukhang ka chen brgyad/ rnam par sgo gsum/ khyams ka ba bzhi cu zhe brgyad kyi sa/ yongs su ka ba lnga cu khyon/ gse 'khru khru nyi shu lnga pa/ rten gyi gtso bor rdo rje gdan gyis mahā bhu dhi'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i byang chub chen po'i sku'i thog drangs/ steng 'og gis lha khang thams cad nas gser sku/ lder sku gzhal yas khang blos bslangs/ la sogs bris legs pa ngo mtshar can gyis yongs su gang bar bzhugs cing*/ bstan gtso'i spyan snga na/gser kong*/ dngul kong | man+ḍal chen mos thog drangs/ lha khang spyir dgos kun na/ mar me 'khor yug dang*/ mchod pa'i rgyun phun sum tshogs pa btsugs/ dgung lo so bdun pa la lcags ri chen mo/ lcog nyi shu sgo chen brgyad/ phyi ljon shing gis ra bas bskor ba dang bcas pa bzhengs/ so dgu pa la sku 'bum chen po bkra shis sgo mang kyi 'gram bting nas/ yun ma 'gyangs par zhabs su chug de rting byams chen gyis gos sku khru brgyad cu pa gcig bzhengs/ rin po che'i bka' 'gyur/ bstan 'gyur bzhengs shing bskor ba dang*/ gzung sngags mang po'i zlas brjod rgyun pa btsugs/ phu ru sgrub pa po brgya rtsa brgyad bzhugs pa'i/

ri khrod dga' ldan gyis 'gram gting*/ 'di ltar bshad grwa sgom grwa 'dzugs pa/ rten lha khang bzhengs pa/ bod 'brog dge rgyun la sbyor ba/ mnga' zhabs la khral 'chag ster ba sogs/ dkar phyogs kyi mdzad 'phrin kho na gtso bor 'don cing*/ phun sum tshogs pa chen po bco brgyad dang*/ nye ba'i phun tshogs bco brgyad dang ldan pas/sems can thams cad bde ba'i lam la bkod do/ /mi dbang de'i rnam thar thugs rgyud la/ /'khrungs pa'i dge las byed dang byed 'gyur dang*/ /'gro la phan bde'i sgrub pa 'di ltas na/ /byams mgon 'asgrub klasprulablupa yin par kun gyi bsngags/ zhes pa rnams chos khrims dar bar mdzad pa'i rnam thar zur tsam bkod pa'o/ /rgyal khrims bde bas bskyangs tshul ni/ gzhon nu nyid nas rtsa ba'i dpon yang*/ 'khon gyis gdung rgyud rin chen rnams kyi zhabs la gtug | yab khu'o bgres rim rnams gtsug tu khur/ bting 'jags thon/ rgya ta ming rgyal pos ta'i si tu'i mtshan dang*/ dngul dam lung gnang sbyin dang bcas pa gnang*/ stag tshang rdzong pa dang*/ dpon blon sngar las kyang nye bar 'brel nas/ mi dbang nam mkha' la sogs pa'i thugs sras su gyur cing*/ lte rtse rdzaung gis gnyed las bzung nas/ zhabs tog tshul bzhin du bsgrubs/ bzhi thog gdung rgyud pas/ sku phra mo nas/ mnga' zhabs byin dge ba bskul cing*/ kun gyis chos rgyal chen mor mtshan gsol/ dpung mi lag tu zas nor gdangs nas/

ngal dub dang phangs pa med pa'i phan cha mdzad pa'i/ srid rtogs yar 'phel du gyur/ mi mthun phyogs pa'i thad du dpa' dpung mdzoms pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ yar mar gang du su dang thug kyang*/ byus kyis rgyal kha lon cing*/ nor bu khyung rtse dang*/ g.yul rgyal stag rtse/ stong du ldan dkar rdzong*/ smad du yar 'brog stag lung*/ lho brag skor la sogs/ rdzong bzhi'i/ mnga' zhabs gsar du chod pa mang zhing*/ khri skor brtan ling gtso bor ston pas/ chen po dgra la byams byas nas/ /tha mar dgra' bo dbang du bsdud/ /mang pos bkur bas kun bskyang sa'i/ /kun gyis rgyal po dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ srid mi gcig pa rnams kyang srid la mthun par byed do/ /'dir sde srid 'dzin pa'i 'gog klagoblus/ mthon por phebs nas/ mnga' zhabs sngar yod rnams/ bo zags med pa'i steng du | rtsa srid byin po'i gtso bor gyur cing*/ gdan sa chen po dang*/ dpal ldan lha rtse/ mdog mus/ chu 'dus man/ gong dkar/ 'phyongs rgyas stag rtse yan/'brel chags su zin na'ang*/ byang phyogs kyis srid po rnams kyang*/ de'i bka' lung dang du len cing*/ de dag thams cad kyi rgyal khrims bdag po/ mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur pas na/ sku lnga'i gzi 'od gsung gis nga ro dang*/ thugs kyis stobs kyi rgyal khrims snon pa dang*/ phyag rdor gyi sprul pa yin zhes tshig don mthun par grags/ bar pa nang chen rab 'byor 'phags pas/ sa skya nang sor phebs nas ti shri chen po chos rgyal theg chen chos rgyal gyi thog drangs pa'i | gdung rgyud khu dbon pa'i zhabs tog dang*/ sde srid kyis 'dzin skyong rnams kyang*/ gcen gyis dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i/ rang phyogs la byang sems dang ldan zhing*/ gzhan phyogs su non shin tu che zhes phyi nang kun tu bstod cing smon pa'i gnas su gyur to/ /gcung po dmag dpon bkra shis 'phags pa ni sku gzhon nu nyid nas/

yab mes gong ma rnams kyi mdzad srol dang mthun par/ dgra ri dgas kyi phyogs la zhal bstan pa tsam gyis/ pha rol 'pham par nus kyis/ byus dang dgra thabs la shin tu phan pas/ dus kun tu g.yul las rgyal ba kho na byung pas na/ dmag dpon rin chen dang chos mtshungs la/ de'i don gyi gnad gang che'i rdzong sa bzung du bzhugs pas/ mnga' zhabs yar 'phel du chod pa/ kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa 'dis/ mi dbang sku mched de rnams kyi dbon sras/ drung bkra shis rab bstan 'phags pa/ dpal bzang po de nyid kyang*/ chos 'brangs khungs nas byung ba yis/ rje btsun gyi yon tan thams cad tshang bas/ chos rgyal chen po'i zhal nas/ 'di ni sde srid kyis bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam par 'gyur ro gsungs shing*/ mdzad 'phrin mthong thos kyi skye bo thams cad kyang mgrin gcig tu bstod cing*/ snyan grags brjod cing sku brtan par bzhugs pa lags so/ /chos rgyal sku mched yab sras mnga' thang dang*/ /blon po sde byus khur gyis mi ngal zhing*| |zhi brag thabs lam blo gros bang mdzod rgyas/ /sdug bsngal nad gsol sman pa'i rgyal po dang*/ /shes rab spyan ldan 'jam dbyangs dpon btsun dang*/ /sde byus bya ba mkhas pa sangs rgyal gsum/ /'di 'dra'i blon rje na rim snan pa yis/ /sde pa su lang 'dug pa mthong ma myong*/ /rje blon shas che sde byus byung pa rnams/ /shes la 'chol dang bcol bas byed pa ste/ /kun la dkon kyang 'di na 'dzaums pa 'di/ /byang sems sprul pa'i 'di'i sde bar go /'di la smon rnams 'di 'dra mdzad par rigs/ /slar yang rje dpon sku tshe brtan pa dang*| |zhal ngo 'phel zhing mnga' thang rgyas pa dang*/ /chab srid dar zhing rgyas par shog /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/lha dbang sprul pa dpal ldan shar dga'i byung tshul/ -PAGE 220--PAGE 219-
